I replied to Dana in your direct message with them. I confirmed their Tamsin Cold Chain pickups now use Dock 15 and that I'll keep it private.

On purpose, I didn't save it to the shared knowledge base (GBrain), because other people can read it there. The note exists only in that direct message. I searched the shared notes first and found nothing that conflicts with it. There's no earlier dock number on record for Tamsin, only unrelated support issues at their Tacoma yard.
